title: 第15章 泰山大人杀上门第16章 商红尘杀上门了
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 翌日清晨。
露水尚未干透，些许阳光刚刚冒上山头，照亮了山顶的一角，龙蛇山下迎来了一个新的客人，陈初阳照常起来干活，收割灵草，整理灵药，查看龙蛇山的情况。
采摘那些成熟的灵果和灵药，还要处理一些虫害，虫子不多，也就是一些小虫子，可逃不过陈初阳的双眼，早早起来干活，这些事情成为了他的日常生活，充实他的生活，缓慢抚平他的心境，那颗心越发平静。
似乎没有什么事情可以打断他的这种生活，沉淀下来的生活，让他的心境开始了缓慢提升，每天提升不多，可也能感受到心境的提升，鱼塘里的鱼儿吃饱了一样，好些鱼儿浮在了水面上，没有昨晚的严重，昨晚倒了药液下去之后，许多鱼儿直接浮在水面上，白了。
一开始陈初阳以为它们死了，检查过后发现并不是，那些鱼儿是醉了，不是死了，于是就没管这些鱼儿，过了一个晚上，大部分鱼儿都清醒了，回归了鱼塘底部，剩下的那些鱼儿估计是喝太多药液，导致它们至今没能醒来。
鱼塘的鱼儿长大了不少，只是一个晚上，陈初阳能够感受到那些鱼儿的成长，可惜了，这些灵鱼没有诞生灵智的存在，大部分都是普通的灵鱼，拿来售卖和吃的鱼儿，陈初阳养殖的都是一些吃的灵鱼，味道不鲜美的不要。
经过了重重挑选之后，剩下来的鱼儿都是好吃的鱼儿。
喂养鱼儿，陈初阳捉起了一条鱼儿，查看了一下，丢回去鱼塘，鱼儿进入了鱼塘，瞬间消失无踪影。
“药液对这些鱼儿的效果很好，都长大了不少，灵性增加，可惜了，还是无法打开灵智。”
“下一次倒药液的时候，要注意一点，可不能……全部倒进去。”
鱼塘的鱼儿都毒死的话，岂不是？
好在他知道药液没有毒，陈初阳思索着如何调配药液的时候，诧异抬头，看向了山脚下。
“那是？”
陈初阳看到了一道熟悉而有些慌张的身影，那个身影正在呐喊，让陈初阳打开阵法，让他上去，很显然是有备而来，没有直接冲上来。
流水迷雾阵打开了一个口子，陈初阳知道躲不过去，只能够面对。
半炷香后。
鱼塘边上多了一道身影。
商应年阴沉着脸，盯着陈初阳，双眼从登山开始，就盯着他，没有转移开一次，周围的灵药和灵鱼无法引起他的兴趣，双手握紧拳头，随时想要动手，他忍住了怒火，没有动手。
他是偷偷前来，没有告诉任何人，哪怕是自己的宝贝女儿也没有告诉。
这件事情，他要自己来处理。
“陈初阳，说吧，你想要怎么处理？”
陈初阳眨眼，疑惑看着商应年，他的前任泰山大人，现如今，可不是了。
他似乎也不需要慌张，更加不需要害怕他。
对哦，陈初阳这才醒悟，那自己有什么好忌讳的。
“什么怎么处理？”
商应年暴躁了，青筋暴露。
“昨夜，红雪深夜回家。”
话，停顿了一下。
他的眼神很吓人，真的要吃了陈初阳一样。
“我看到红雪眼睛红了，她也吐了。”
“是不是你做的？”
陈初阳眼睛瞪大，好像，似乎，这件事情和自己有关，他下意识点头。
看到他点头，商应年更加怒了。
“果然是你，陈初阳，你个臭小子，你怎么能够如此做？红雪可……是你……小姨子，再怎么说你也不能动红雪，你是不是故意报复我商家的？我知道，红尘退婚对你影响很大，这一点，我很抱歉。”
“我已经和你父母商讨过了，他们也同意了，我们商家会做出赔偿，你也不能……不讲信用，既然答应了退婚了，为何还要祸害红雪？”
content_en:
The next morning.
The dew has not yet dried up, and a little sunshine has just risen to the top of the mountain, illuminating a corner of the top of the mountain. A new guest has been welcomed at the foot of Longshe Mountain. Chen Chuyang got up to work as usual, harvesting spiritual grass, sorting out elixirs, and checking the situation of Longshe Mountain.
Picking those ripe spiritual fruits and elixirs, you also have to deal with some insect pests. There are not many bugs, just some small bugs, but they can't escape Chen Chuyang's eyes. Getting up early to work, these things have become his daily life, enriching his life, slowly soothing his mood, and his heart becomes calmer and calmer.
It seemed that nothing could interrupt his life. The settled life began to slowly improve his mood. The improvement was not much every day, but he could still feel the improvement in his mood. The fish in the fish pond seemed to be full, and many fish were floating on the water. It was not as serious as last night. After pouring the liquid medicine last night, many fish floated directly on the water and turned white.
At first, Chen Chuyang thought they were dead, but after checking, he found that it was not the case. The fish were drunk, not dead, so he ignored them. After one night, most of the fish woke up and returned to the bottom of the fish pond. The remaining fish probably drank too much medicine, which has caused them to still not wake up.
The fish in the fish pond have grown up a lot. In just one night, Chen Chuyang can feel the growth of those fish. Unfortunately, these spiritual fish have not been born with spiritual beings. Most of them are ordinary spiritual fish. The fish that are sold and eaten. Chen Chuyang breeds some spiritual fish that are not delicious.
After many selections, the remaining fish are all delicious fish.
While feeding the fish, Chen Chuyang caught a fish, checked it, and threw it back into the fish pond. The fish entered the fish pond and disappeared without a trace in an instant.
"The medicinal liquid has a very good effect on these fish. They have grown a lot and their spiritual intelligence has increased. Unfortunately, they still cannot open their spiritual intelligence."
"Next time when you pour the liquid medicine, be careful not to... pour it all in."
Wouldn't it be wrong if all the fish in the fish pond were poisoned to death?
Fortunately, he knew that the liquid was not poisonous. When Chen Chuyang was thinking about how to prepare the liquid, he raised his head in surprise and looked at the foot of the mountain.
"That is?"
Chen Chuyang saw a familiar and somewhat panicked figure. The figure was shouting for Chen Chuyang to open the formation and let him go up. It was obvious that he was prepared and did not rush forward directly.
The flowing water mist formation opened a hole, and Chen Chuyang knew that he couldn't hide from it, so he could only face it.
After half a stick of incense.
There is an additional figure beside the fish pond.
Shang Yingnian stared at Chen Chuyang with a gloomy face. His eyes had been fixed on him since the beginning of the mountain climbing, and he did not look away once. The elixirs and fish around him could not arouse his interest. He clenched his fists and wanted to make a move at any time. He suppressed his anger and did not make a move.
He came secretly and didn't tell anyone, not even his precious daughter.
He had to handle this matter himself.
"Chen Chuyang, tell me, how do you want to deal with it?"
Chen Chuyang blinked and looked at Shang Yingnian in confusion. His predecessor, Lord Taishan, was no longer the one.
He didn't seem to need to panic, let alone be afraid of him.
That's right, Chen Chuyang finally realized that he had something to be taboo about.
"How to deal with what?"
"You..."
Shang Yingnian was irritable and his veins were exposed.
"Last night, Hongxue came home late at night."
Then, there was a pause.
His eyes were scary, as if he really wanted to eat Chen Chuyang.
"I saw Hongxue's eyes were red and she also vomited."
"Did you do it?"
Chen Chuyang's eyes widened, as if, it seemed, this matter had something to do with him, and he nodded subconsciously.
Seeing him nodding, Shang Yingnian became even more angry.
"As expected, it's you, Chen Chuyang, you brat, how could you do this? Hongxue...it's you...sister-in-law, no matter what, you can't touch Hongxue. Are you deliberately retaliating against my business? I know that Hongchen's breakup of the engagement has had a great impact on you. I'm sorry for this."
"I have discussed it with your parents, and they have agreed. Our business will compensate you, and you can't...not be trustworthy. Since you agreed to break off the engagement, why do you want to harm Hongxue?"
